--- a/reference/jets.py
+++ b/reference/jets.py
@@ -114,7 +114,7 @@
         delta = self-self.value
         term = Jet.constant(mp.mpf(1), self.degree)
         result = term
-        for k in range(1, self.degree+1):
+        for k in range(1, self.degree<<1):
             term = term*delta / k
             result = result+term
         return result*mp.exp(self.value)
equivalent.justification: The extra Taylor powers vanish in the truncated algebra: delta has zero constant coefficient, so powers greater than degree are identically zero. Both shifted bounds include every required term for degrees 0 through 4. Inputs and exponents are required finite.
